title.narrative: Strengthening Land Administration & Registration Processes IDF Grant

description.narrative: This request is to support the Office of the Minister Plenipotentiary / Minister Plenipotentiary is a person empowered to act on behalf of government as mandated. / and the Council for Cadastre which involves the three ministries -- the Ministry of Finance, Justice and Regional Development and Construction / In mid- 2000 the Surveyor General and the Office of Geodesy and Cartography, was transferred to the Ministry of Regional Development and Construction, from the Ministry of Interior. / -- in the development and implementation of the required national framework for an integrated cadastre system and action plans for the efficient functioning of land registration, property tax and cadastral surveying in Poland. The objective of the requested IDF grant is to assist in the institutional development of the Office and Council in its formative stages, and the development of a National Framework for Integrated Cadastral System in Poland, and the further development of a pilot project addressing land administration and registration, in Bytom. An extension of this pilot project (supported by funds from the Government of Australia between 1996-2000) would be used for development of principles and solutions for the integrated cadastral system in Poland, and to serve as a demonstration site to test methods of working together including technically and financially - with the three participating agencies and users. It would be titled a national framework development site (NFDS). The overall integrated cadastre program for Poland is estimated to total US$500 million over a period of about 15 years.
